FileHeader.Mode.claim: Selects Unix or DOS attribute interpretation by creator and adds the directory bit when the name ends in a raw slash.

FileHeader.Mode.configurations: Pinned native entry points through a same-package test overlay and compiled Lean. Each declaration is checked in 139,264 fixed rows and 60,000 sampled rows using seeds 17, 2718 and 65537.
